entities.summary: Lake Chervonoye is a large freshwater lake in Zhytkavichy District, Gomel Oblast, Belarus. Located at 52.4°N 27.95°E, it has an area of 40.8 km2 (15.8 mi2) and a maximum depth of 2.9 m (9.5 ft).
